notes.title: Initial version online announcement
notes.content:
It's a great pleasure to meet you on steam platform. Infected Prison has been released today. I would like to express my deep gratitude to the players who have been following and supporting us all the time!

At present, for the initial preemptive version of the game, more content is still being produced and improved, including but not limited to the following content:

1. More levels and plot content.
2. More art and music content.
3. Necessary optimization for equipment.
4. Open up more ways to play games.
5. Improve the details of the current version.

The above is what we plan to update next time. We welcome everyone's active experience and evaluation. We will listen to players' opinions and suggestions carefully, and we will bring you more and better experience of game content in the future.

Thanks again! On the occasion of the Chinese new year, I wish you a happy New Year! Good luck in the year of the ox!
